narrative: 体育、追逐、一个只有在跑一圈时才感到活着的角色：摄影机要么足够宽广或足够高，能看清整个环道，要么用长焦压缩背部直道，同时赛道涂装依然能证明这是一个环形赛道。贴地疾驰（Road Rush）是柏油路面的主观视角。
而这个是速度的体育场。用在没有护栏的开放道路上，它是错误的工具；如果赞助商字样变得清晰可辨，也是错误的用法。
字母会显得混乱失真。展现出只有赛道才有的那种涂装。
how: 足够高或足够宽广，能看清环形赛道，从内场用24mm焦段拍摄，或在直道上用135mm焦段做压缩。涂装的路缘石、防护网、看台。
赛车上的热浪或运动感。不要出现清晰可辨的赞助商字样。
提示词：Prompt: Race-track world of [Subject], oval geometry, painted curbs, grandstands, speed as a closed loop.
when: 一圈跑道、一场同时也是体育项目的追逐、一个困在内场的角色。不要用在泛泛的高速公路上。
vs: 贴地疾驰是疾驰的柏油路面主观视角。追车镜头（Car Chasing）是追逐场面的拍摄。
赛道则是作为美术置景的闭环：环道、涂装、看台。如果你看不到这个赛道环形，你身处的只是一条公路，而不是赛道。
examples_film: 《壮志雄心》（Grand Prix, 1966）把赛道当作一种建筑来处理。《极速车王》（Ford v Ferrari）把身体和机器放进了那片涂装和那些看台之中。
一个速度的闭环。这是语法，而不是照搬某个弯角。
mistakes: 一辆车行驶在泛泛的高速公路上，或清晰可辨的商标。破绽是没有环形赛道，也没有涂装。
修正方法：路缘石、防护网、看台，以及一个闭环。

faq.q: 电影中的赛道（Race Track）是什么？
faq.a: 一种场景风格：赛道的几何形状、涂装的路缘石、看台，速度成为一个闭环。这个环形赛道就是场景本身，而不是一条高速公路。

faq.q: 赛道（Race Track）与贴地疾驰（Road Rush）的区别
faq.a: 贴地疾驰是柏油路面上的主观速度感。赛道则是那种速度的体育场：环道、涂装、看台。如果你看不清这个环形，你想要的是贴地疾驰或一场追逐戏。
体育、追逐、一圈就是整个世界。跳过泛泛的高速公路。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写赛道的提示词？
faq.a: 先说明环道、路缘石、看台，然后禁止出现赞助商字样。

narrative: Sport, pursuit, a character who only feels alive on a lap: the camera is wide enough or high enough to read the loop, or telephoto-compressed on the back straight with the paint still proving it is a circuit. Road-rush is tarmac POV.
This is the stadium of speed. It is the wrong tool on an open road with no barriers, and the wrong tool if sponsor type becomes readable.
Letters garble. Show the paint that only a track has.
how: High enough or wide enough to read the oval, 24mm from the infield, or 135mm compressed on the straight. Painted curbs, catch fence, grandstand.
Heat haze or motion on the cars. No readable sponsor type.
Prompt: Race-track world of [Subject], oval geometry, painted curbs, grandstands, speed as a closed loop.
when: A lap, a pursuit that is also sport, a character stranded in the infield. Do not use it on a generic highway.
vs: Road Rush is the rushing tarmac POV. Car Chasing is pursuit coverage.
Race track is the closed loop as production design: oval, paint, stands. If you cannot see the circuit, you are on a road, not a track.
examples_film: Grand Prix (1966) treats the circuit as architecture. Ford v Ferrari puts bodies and machines inside that paint and those stands.
A closed loop of speed. Grammar, not a copied corner.
mistakes: A car on a generic highway, or readable logos. The tell is no oval and no paint.
Fix it: curbs, fencing, grandstands, closed loop.

faq.q: What is Race Track in film?
faq.a: A location look: circuit geometry, painted curbs, grandstands, speed as a closed loop. The oval is the set, not a highway.
Road rush is POV speed on tarmac. Race track is the stadium of that speed: oval, paint, stands. If you cannot read the loop, you wanted road rush or a chase.

faq.q: When should I use Race Track?
faq.a: Sport, pursuit, a lap that is the world. Skip generic highways.

faq.q: How do I prompt Race Track for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name oval, curbs, stands, then: Race-track world of [Subject], oval geometry, painted curbs, grandstands, speed as a closed loop. Forbid sponsor type.
